messages:
maria: FYI AcmeCorp reporting sudden 429s from their dedicated pool after the config push at ~10:03 UTC. They say job spikes (batch embeddings) started failing. I have a sample response header below.

alex: Can you drop the request-id and full response headers? also which pool (dedicated-id)?

maria: dedicated-acme-02, request-id: r-0a1b2c3d. Response headers:```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 600
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 164
X-Tenant-Quota-Units: 100
X-Tenant-Quota-Unit-Type: request
Retry-After: 30
```

sam: That X-Tenant-Quota-Unit-Type stands out — looks like the tenant quota was applied in "request" units. Acme's workload is token-heavy; their dedicated reservation was configured expecting token units. If the config flip happened, a small request limit will exhaust immediately.

jin: I'm pulling quota-service config now. I see a recent config entry for tenant=acme created by deploy pipeline: commit abc123. Snip from store:```
tenant: acme
quota: { limit: 100, unit: request, window_seconds: 60 }
```
This would be 100 requests/min, which is way lower than their prior token-based reservation.

deploy-bot: deployed config change commit=abc123 by pipeline/main at 2026-02-15T10:03:14Z (staged: quota-service, config-service) :rocket:

alex: That explains the timing. Looks like the config schema change in the pipeline accidentally mapped unit_type->request for tenants that previously had token. We need a hotfix: either revert commit abc123 or reapply tenant override with correct unit.

maria: Customer impact: many batch workers get 429s, retries cause backoff and some job failures. They asked for ETA to fix — they can tolerate short restart if needed.

sam: Quick repro steps I used from my laptop:```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACME_API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"long text...","max_tokens":2048}' \n  https://dedicated.us-east.redwood/api/v1/generate
```
Response includes the headers above. If you hammer with 20 parallel requests you hit remaining=0 within seconds.

jin: Proposed immediate remediation (2 options):
1) Patch quota-service tenant entry: set unit->token and limit->6000 (tokens/min) for acme; reload config; invalidate quota cache.
2) Roll back commit abc123 entirely to previous config set.

I can push option 1 as a hotfix (less intrusive).

alex: Go for option 1. Also add a short-term uplift so customer jobs finish while we validate.

jin: Applying hotfix now. Steps I'm running:```bash
# admin API change
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/quota/update" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"tenant":"acme","quota":{"limit":6000,"unit":"token","window_seconds":60}}'

# reload config cache
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/quota/reload" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"

# purge local caches on feeders
for p in feeder-1 feeder-2 feeder-3; do \n  curl -X POST "https://$p.internal/cache/purge?key=tenant:acme:quota" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" &
done
```

sam: Logs while patching:```
[10:07:12] quota-service: updating tenant=acme -> unit=token limit=6000
[10:07:13] cache-invalidator: queued purge for feeders (3)
[10:07:14] quota-service: reload complete (commit=abc123-hotfix)
```

maria: Customer confirms a drop in 429s after ~90s. They report most batch jobs resumed successfully.

alex: Nice. Permanent follow-ups:
- SUP-4321: add pre-deploy validation to pipeline to assert that tenant unit_type is not unintentionally changed (token vs request).
- SUP-4322: add an alert when unit_type flips for a tenant on dedicated pools.
- SUP-4323: improve config rollout docs for quota semantics (tokens vs requests).

jin: I'll create PR to add the validation tests and link SUP tickets. Also will rollback commit abc123 on staging and run canary.

sam: We should also surface clearer headers to customers (X-Tenant-Quota-Unit-Type) — it's there but not obvious. Maybe include human-readable message in 429 body.

maria: Customer wants a postmortem and timeline. I'll own comms.

alex: Marking incident as resolved for now. Moving to postmortem lane. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: note: hotfix deployed commit=abc123-hotfix at 2026-02-15T10:07:14Z

maria: thanks all. Closing loop with Acme and will attach logs.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from alex, :eyes: from jin)
